title: Logic Gates and Logic Circuits
overview: A focused revision guide to logic gates and logic circuits.

sections.title: Basic gates
content: Know the truth tables for AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR cold — these underpin every logic circuit question.

sections.title: Circuits ↔ expressions
content: Be able to convert fluently both ways: write the Boolean expression from a given circuit diagram, and describe/draw a circuit from an expression such as Q = (A·B) + (¬C).

examTips: Build a truth table for your derived expression and compare it against the circuit's own truth table as a fast self-check.
